thread:
Eli: Quick sync 1 1 inbound asks for an 'Optimize Advisor' (batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts). Need to pick a realistic v0 for the next sprint.

Priya: Recommend v0 = read-only advisor + eval-triggered alerts (no auto-apply). Acceptance: sample checks (3/5 prompts) show cost/latency wins w/o quality drops; concordance alert threshold 0.92; p95 short-chat latency <200ms when suggestions shown.

Jonah: Implementation constraints: two quant tiers (safe=int8 post-train, aggressive=int4/QAT). Include risk_score and projected mem/latency delta per rec. Batching hints should come as a small DSL (max_batch_tokens, preferred_batch_size, pad_strategy).

Marta: FastForms = pilot candidate (throughput-first). HealthEdge = conservative (needs audit + KMS). Pilot FastForms first; HealthEdge later with audit checklist.

Priya: Alerts: concordance on customer editablesets, tokens-per-infer trend, p99 latency anomalies. Notify Slack + email + ops ticket. Make eval-sets editable in Console; mark "sensitive" to require manual approval for future auto-apply.

Jonah: Note: KV-cache + quant can drift on long contexts >1024add warning in recs.

Eli: Scope locked for sprint: ship v0 read-only advisor + eval alerts; pilot FastForms only. Owners: Priya (PM), Jonah (eng lead), Marta (cust).

DevBot: runbook created -> /runbooks/optimize-advisor-v0 :white_check_mark:

Eli: If no objections by EOD I'll lock the sprint card.
